title: A Spire for the Choir
author: Ivo Hartwell
blurb: Beatrix Quintana, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
